purpose: Deterministic TPM query fixture that replays a committed conditional-probability request against the supported TPM artifact fixture.

provenance.author: OpenAI Codex

provenance.generation_command: Replay query_tpm_artifact(load_tpm_artifact("tests/fixtures/tpm/tpm_artifact_v1.json"), TPMQueryRequest(...)) using the committed supported artifact and persist the exact expected result payload.
